title: Do not buy this is horrible
text:
Do not buy this is horrible. The material is cheap and it was over priced the material was clumped in the middle it had huge balls of the inside stuffing bunched together, it was had holes all over.
it was a disgusting blanket I will never buy this again ever it is so cheap it was falling apart.
Its not even work making into a dog blanket I ended up throwing it in the trash i spent almost $60 for this Garbage.
The picture shows a very nice Blanket but once it arrived I was so super upset when i seen the trash that was sent to me.
